questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The car hit the pole beside the shop before the accident.

options.text: The pole beside the shop were hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop had been hit by the car before the accident.
The pole beside the shop hit by the car before the accident.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In order to convert an** active sentence to a passive sentence**, we need to make the object of the active sentence the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• In this case, the object of the active sentence is **"the pole beside the shop".**
 
• The subject of the active voice **'the car' **will become the object of the passive voice.
 
• We also need to use the appropriate form of the verb **"to be" **and the past participle of the main verb **"hit". **
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Therefore, the correct passive sentence is** *"The pole beside the shop was hit by the car before the accident." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because "were" is not the correct form of the verb "to be" to use with "pole".
 
• **Option 3 **is incorrect because "had been hit" implies that the action happened before another past action, which is not the case in this sentence.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because it is not a grammatically correct passive sentence.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Dictatorship
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Democracy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the word **"Dictatorship" **is** "Democracy". **
 
• **Dictatorship** refers to **a form of government where one person or a group of people hold absolute power and authority over the citizens. **
 
• In a dictatorship, the ruler(s) have complete control over the government, economy, and society, and there is no room for opposition or dissent.
 
 
• Examples of dictatorships include North Korea, Cuba, and Syria.
 
 
 
• On the other hand, **Democracy **is **a form of government where the power is vested in the people, who exercise it directly or through elected representatives. In a democracy, citizens have the right to vote, express their opinions, and participate in the decision-making process.**
 
 
• Examples of democracies include the United States, Canada, and India.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options given are:
 
• **Monarchy**: A form of government where a monarch, such as a king or queen, holds supreme power. In a monarchy, the ruler's power is usually inherited and not based on merit or popular support.
 
 
• Examples of monarchies include the United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, and Thailand.
 
 
 
• **Republic**: A form of government where the power is held by the people or their elected representatives. In a republic, the head of state is usually a president, who is elected by the people or the parliament.
 
 
• Examples of republics include France, Italy, and the United States.
 
 
 
• **Communism**: A political and economic ideology that advocates for a classless society where the means of production are owned and controlled by the community as a whole. In a communist system, there is no private property, and the government controls all aspects of the economy.
 
 
• Examples of communist countries include China, Cuba, and Vietnam."

questions.question:
**Substitute one word for the italicised expression.**

Shelley was also known for his association with John Keats and Lord Byron as these were __*the men living in the same age*__.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is** contemporaries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contemporaries"** means **people who lived during the same time period.** In this sentence, Shelley is known for his association with John Keats and Lord Byron because they all lived during the same time period. 

 
 
• Example: Shakespeare and Christopher Marlowe were **contemporaries **in the Elizabethan era.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options:**
 
• **Preceding**: This means coming before in time or order. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because Shelley's association with Keats and Byron was not about them coming before him in time or order. 
 
 
• Example: The **preceding **chapter in the book discussed the history of the city.
 
 
 
• **Old-fashioned: **This means out of date or no longer in fashion. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because it does not accurately describe Shelley's association with Keats and Byron. 
 
 
• Example: My grandmother's taste in clothing is very** old-fashioned.**
 
 
 
• **Succeeding: **This means coming after in time or order. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because Shelley's association with Keats and Byron was not about them coming after him in time or order. 
 
 
• Example: The **succeeding **chapter in the book will discuss the author's personal experiences.
 
 
 
• Overall,** "contemporaries" **is the best word to use in this sentence because it accurately describes the relationship between Shelley, Keats, and Byron as people who lived during the same time period.

• **Option 4, "Molecules", **is not correct as phytoplankton are not molecules. Rather, they are made up of many different types of molecules, such as chlorophyll, which allows them to perform photosynthesis.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
